title: Video / Image Block
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As a** content editor

**I want to** easily insert and manage media content (images and videos) in my layouts

**So that** I can create visually engaging content for all users across different devices

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

### Acceptance Criteria:

* **Image Display:**

    * I can place single images in common formats (JPG, PNG, WebP)
    * I can set alternative text for accessibility
    * I can define image dimensions and aspect ratios
    * Images are responsive and adjust to different screen sizes
    
* **Video Integration:**

    * I can upload videos or embed from external sources (YouTube, Vimeo)
    * Videos are displayed in a responsive player
    * I can set custom thumbnails for videos
    * Auto-play settings are configurable
    * **Video Accessibility:**
    
        * Captions must be available for all videos
        * Provide video transcriptions
        * Audio descriptions for important visual content
        * Descriptive video metadata (title, description, duration)
        * High-contrast and customizable video interface
        * Controls must be keyboard-accessible
        
    
* **Enhanced Viewing Experience:**

    * Users can click images to view them in a lightbox
    * The lightbox supports zooming and panning for images
    * Videos open in a modal player with standard controls
    * Navigation between media items in lightbox/modal is possible
    
* **Mobile Considerations:**

    * Media loads optimized versions based on device and connection
    * Touch-friendly controls for lightbox/video player
    * Proper orientation handling for fullscreen mode
    * Bandwidth-conscious loading strategies
    
* **Technical Requirements:**

    * Lazy loading implementation for performance
    * Support for modern image formats and compression
    * Accessible controls and keyboard navigation
    * Cross-browser compatibility
    

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:paintbrush:</custom> Design

Use [Aspect Ratio](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=1-17&m=dev)

* corner radius depends on **forms-border-radius**
* user can deactivate corner radius

enrichedData.purpose: Enables content editors to insert and manage images and videos in layouts, creating visually engaging content that works across all devices
useCases: Place responsive images in common formats with accessibility alt text
Define image dimensions and aspect ratios
Upload videos or embed from YouTube and Vimeo
Configure video auto-play settings and custom thumbnails
Open images in a lightbox with zoom and pan support
Play videos in a modal player with standard controls
Navigate between multiple media items in lightbox view
Load optimized media versions based on device and connection
Provide captions and transcriptions for video accessibility
